decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed was significantly cluttered with irrelevant items including tents, camping stoves, trekking poles, sleeping pads, and even a dog tank shirt. Among the actual backpacks, the selection was limited to specialized tactical bags, small sling bags, and one premium Osprey pack priced at over $240 with reviews criticizing its suspension durability. Due to the high volume of non-category items and the specific flaws or highly specialized nature of the available backpacks, none of the options felt like a satisfying purchase for a general browsing session.
